title: The Social Exchange API
philosophicalAnchor: The village square gives way to digital registry. What was shouted now travels as JSON. The API is the ceremony of exchange—structured, predictable, and fair.
pythonConcept: Flask, REST API, routes, HTTP methods, request.json, jsonify, status codes
briefDescription: Build a REST API for a village barter system using Flask, managing items with full CRUD operations.
theoryPillar: REST APIs use HTTP methods as verbs: GET retrieve, POST create, PUT update, DELETE remove. Each returns appropriate status codes: 200 OK, 201 Created, 404 Not Found.
anchorPillar: Village barter system replaces shouting in the square with digital registry. Items have id, name, quantity, owner. The API provides structured exchange through well-defined endpoints.
triggerPillar: Villagers need to list items, add new items, update quantities, and remove traded items. The API must handle errors gracefully and return meaningful status codes.
realityPillar: @app.route('/items', methods=['POST']) creates items. request.json accesses body. jsonify() serializes responses. Global registry dict with counter for unique IDs. 201 for creation, 404 for missing items.
